wiki.summary: "A Way of Life" is a song featured in Persona 3 Portable. Composed by Shoji Meguro, written by Reiko Tanaka and sung by Mayumi Fujita. The song is played when the female protagonist travels around Tatsumi Port Island. It is the second track in the Persona 3 Portable Original Soundtrack. Read more on Last.fm.
